**_TIERED PRODUCTION WITH STACKING BONUSES
_**
**_-- HOW TIERED PRODUCTION WORKS --_**
**Wines, Meads and Jellies can be processed multiple times to produce higher quality products.**

    **Wines & Meads:** When made in Deluxe Wine Keg produce a specific Wine / Mead which can be processed further.
        - Place Wine / Mead back into Deluxe Wine Keg (or into Distillation Tank) to make Brandy / Balsam.
        - Place Brandy + Wine / Balsam + Mead into Deluxe Wine Keg (or Keg) to produce Port Wine / Mead.
            - Wine and Brandy / Mead and Balsam must be from the same fruit or flower to produce a port.
            - Port will always yield 2 bottles, except for certain divine and enchanted crops.
        - Place Wine / Mead into a Fermentation Tank with Yeast to produce Sparkling Wine / Mead

    **Jellies:** When made in Deluxe Preserves Jar produce a specific Jelly which can be processed further.
        - Place Jelly back into Deluxe Preserves Jar with the same type of fruit or flower it is made from to make Jam.
        - Place Jam back into Deluxe Preserves Jar with the same type of fruit or flower it is made from to make Compote / Chutney / Preserves.

    **Teas** become Kombuchas in a Fermentation Tank (requires SCOBY).
        - Infused Teas pick up bonuses from all components used to craft them.

    **Flow Honeys** can become Honey Jelly in Deluxe Preserves Jar and Nectar in a Distillation Tank.

**_-- HOW BONUSES WORK --_**

**Certain crops and items give bonuses when consumed.**

- Items processed into artisan goods will have an increase to each held bonus for every level of production, as well as an increase in bonus duration.

   **Example:**

                Saskatoon                       -     +5 Foraging            -    90 Minutes

                Saskatoon Jelly                  -    +6 Foraging            -    120 Minutes
                Saskatoon Jam                  -    +8 Foraging            -    180 Minutes
                Saskatoon Compote              -    +10 Foraging              -    240 Minutes

                Saskatoon Wine                  -    +6 Foraging, -1 Speed    -    120 Minutes
                Saskatoon Brandy                   -    +8 Foraging, -2 Speed    -    180 Minutes
                Saskatoon Port Wine              -    +10 Foraging, -3 Speed      -    240 Minutes
                Sparkling Saskatoon Wine         -     +8 Foraging, -2 Speed    -    180 Minutes

                Saskatoon Juice                -    +7 Foraging              -    120 Minutes
                Saskatoon Puree                -    +7 Foraging              -    120 Minutes
                Saskatoon Liqueur                 -    +15 Foraging, -5 Speed       -    300 Minutes

**_VANILLA SHOP INVENTORIES ADJUSTED FOR NEW ITEMS._**

**_-- HOW SHOPS WORK --_**

- There are six trees added to Pierre's / Joja's inventory (four unlock in year 2), all other crops and saplings are sold exclusively by the new NPCs.

- Most vendor inventories will have random new items:
     - Clint sells overpriced metal bars in year 2.
     - Gus will sell one random beer, one random soda, one random tea, one random coffee per day.
        - Also sells Pure Water and Lemon Juice
     - Dwarf will sell one random mushroom, one random gem, one random ore per day.  Overpriced rare metal bars in year 2.
     - Harvey will sell one random medicinal extract, one random medicinal powder per day.
        - Also sells mold cultures for Cheese production.
     - Ice Cream Shop sells more ice creams and a few recipes.
     - Krobus sells Void Milk and bacteria cultures for cheese making.
        - Also sells Void Ice Cream & Void Salad Dressing recipes.
     - Marnie sells Milks (Large and special at year 2), Cheese Enzymes, some Machines, random dairy item daily.
     - Pierre / Joja will sell one random artisan good per day. Each day of the week is a different category.
               - (Baking Components, Cereals, Condiments & Sauces, Ground Herbs & Spices, Snacks, etc).
     - Robin sells new wood types and other materials needed for machine crafting.
     - Sandy will sell one random perfume per day.
        - Also sells Annatto Powder and Dill.
     - Soda Machine in Saloon sells a variety of sodas (if Saloon interior not modded).
     - Traveling Merchant will sell one random crop, one random dairy item per day.
     - Willy will sell one random sea forage item per day.

- Desert Trader sells spice mix, sauce and salad dressing recipes in exchange for gemstones.  Recipe yields as many outputs as there are components.
               - Ex: Cajun Seasoning has six components, yields six Cajun Seasonings.

**Detailed descriptions of optional additional content files can be viewed in the [Optional Addon Article](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1158).**

**__________________________________________________**

**_MOD DETAILS:_**

Seven new shops are added to the game in the form of mythical creatures located in different zones of the game. As you increase friendship with the shop-keeps, they will sell you better items.  This is flavored as though you are leaving offerings to the nature spirits, and you are being rewarded for your services.

You are able to produce just about everything that the vendors sell with the right mods. Everything necessary to produce the divine wines cycles through their inventories at random.

**See PRODUCTION articles on the [Articles Tab](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8256?tab=articles) to see input instructions for all producable items added by mod (broken down by machine).**

**_NEW CROPS:

_- 135 New crops**

*   Tea leaves can be processed into several different types of tea, in addition to black tea.  White tea becomes yellow, rooibos becomes red, black can be processed into an additional tea as well; all done via "realistic" means. There are 100+ teas that can be made with this mod.  All teas have unique tea sachets and kombuchas, most have a "tea leaf" or dry mix as well.

*   13 produce giant crops (Some Giant Crop artwork done by [6480](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/55537262)).

*   **Dozens of additional crops produced if [Multi Yield Crops](http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6069)  is used.**
**- 140 New Trees**

*   Plums become prunes in dehydrator, pimento become allspice, grapes become raisins. These new items also act as "fruit" for production purposes.

*   Some of the trees and crops are "legendary" or "mythical" (ie: Yggdrasil which has a Bifrost Flower) which appear as top tier crops.
- Most "divine crops" can be ground into a dust that can be used as an additional "crop" item.
          - Port wines and port meads from these crops have unique names, and can be used as a starting point to produce "Divine Libations" in a keg with the correct ingredients.  These are like potions, are difficult collect components for, and are highly valuable.  There are a lot of these, their input instructions can be found in Grimoires near the new NPC vendors. They can be traded to the Valkyrie Statue for Divine Weapons.

**_NEW MACHINES:
_**
    *Please note that [PFM Automate](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038) is required if you want the Automate mod to function with my machines.

*   Auto Mill - Grinds items into fine powders, dusts, and flours

*   Beverage Keg - Makes sodas, lemonades, and specialty beverages.

*   Churn - Makes dairy butters and creams.

*   Cheese Processor - Makes specialty cheeses.

*   Deluxe Preserves Jar - Makes Jellies that can become Jams and Compotes. Pickles mushrooms and nuts. Makes floral jellies.

*   Deluxe Wine Keg - Makes Wines that can become Brandies and Ports, also makes Meads, Balsams and Port Meads. Makes floral wines.

*   Distillation Tank - Distills liquors and brandies.

*   Dry Packer - Packs tea sachets, cereals, and other items for store sale.

*   Fermentation Tank - Ferments beers, sparkling wines and sparkling ciders.

*   Flow Hive - Turns flowers into honey that can be used to make nectars, jellies and tiered meads.

*   Fragrance Extractor - Makes perfumes and colognes from flowers and other aromatic items.

*   Incubation Tank - Can be used to grow yeasts, bacteria cultures and algae.

*   Juice Keg - Makes fruit juices, vegetable juices and floral waters.

*   Magic Cauldron - Can be used to combine certain special port wines and meads with magic components to craft divine libations.

*   Milk Keg - Produces non-dairy milks from seeds and nuts.

*   Mold Tank - Produces 1 mold strain daily.  Does not need loaded (acts like Bee House).

*   Oxidizer - Processes teas, dehydrates, dries.

*   Puree Jar - Makes fruit purees, nut butters and other smooth artisan goods.

*   Tea Keg - Keg that makes teas from flowers, herbs and certain other ingredients.
**_EXPANDED PRODUCTION ADD ON_**

*   Dye Washer - Dyes wool to make colorful fabrics.

*   Paint Mixer - Mixes colorful paints. This is flavored as selling directly to Leah.

*   Tea Packer - Makes Tea Sachets which can rapidly brew tea in Keg and Tea Keg

**_NEW PRODUCTION:

_*** Please note, these are for Raffadax crops and vanilla game assets only...

**- Crops have production for:__**        -Wine, Brandy, Port Wine, Sparkling Wine, Honey, Mead, Balsam, Port Mead, Sparkling Mead, Jelly, Jam, Compote, Honey Jelly, Butter, Fruit Juice, Vegetable Juice, Pickles, Tea, Tea Sachets, Kombucha, Liquor, Nectar, Grinder, Dryer, Dehydrator, Oil Maker, Mayo Machine, Non-Dairy Milk, Perfume, Roasted

**- 50+ Cheeses & Butters**

**_NEW NPCs:

_**- Seven new friendable NPCs as shop-keeps. Their item availability is linked to their friendship points. It is advised that you read the mail they send. They send very detailed mail that explains how a few mod specific things work.

*   Portrait Artwork for NPCs by [AberjaxStudios](https://www.etsy.com/shop/AberjaxStudios/) .

*   Portrait artwork & sprite work for Astrid and Valkyrie Statue portrait done by [FellowClown](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/74479268).
- Full unique gift tastes for every item for every character in the game (including Leo), the new NPCs, and the following original NPCs:

*   [Boarding House](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4120)  - Gregory, Sheila

*   [East Scarpe](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787) - Eloise, Jacob, [Beatrice](http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7042)

*   [Garden Village](http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6113)  -  Hekate, Hephaestus

*   [Stardew Valley Expanded](http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753)  - Andy, Apples, Claire, Gunther, Marlon, Martin, Morgan, Morris, Olivia, Sophia, Susan, Victor

**_NEW FORAGABLES:
_**

*   50+ New Items

*   Feathers, antlers, shells, shark teeth, mushrooms.

*   Kelp found at beach has vegetable artisan production.

*   Some items only appear when it is storming or snowing.

*   Some "legendary items" can be found very rarely (1/1000) that can be sold or made into valuable items.

**_NEW WEAPONS:
_**

*   60+ Divine weapons which can be traded for divine wines at the volcano caldera.
